name: Rui Chen
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Bilibili Inc. (NASDAQ: BILI / HKEX: 9626)
profile: Chen Rui (b. 1978, Chengdu) spent years at Kingsoft (Kingsoft Antivirus engine, later GM of the antivirus unit), co-founded Kingsoft Network (now Cheetah Mobile), angel-invested in Bilibili in 2011 and became its chairman in 2014. His wealth comes from his Bilibili stake; he still leads the video community as chairman and CEO.
interesting_fact: He was an angel investor in Bilibili in 2011 when it was a small hobbyist site, advised it for years, and joined full-time as chairman after Cheetah Mobile's 2014 IPO.
deep_cut_fact: In 2008 he left Kingsoft to found 'Beike Anquan' (贝壳安全), described as China's first cloud-security vendor; Kingsoft bought it in 2010 and he returned as a co-founder of Kingsoft Network (Cheetah Mobile). He is a long-time ACG fan and was among Bilibili's first ~210,000 users.
notes: Has a public Weibo and Bilibili space (linked from zh.wikipedia). Joined Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Media & Communication as adjunct professor in Dec 2021. Best formal route: Bilibili IR/media contact.
